svg.title: Bayu Anchor breadboard wiring
svg.desc: Phase-0 breadboard wiring of the Bayu Anchor node: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 with the Wio-SX1262 LoRa board stacked on top, Sensirion SEN54 and SHT40 on I2C (D4 SDA, D5 SCL) with 4.7 kOhm pull-ups to 3V3, Plantower PMS5003 on UART (D6 TX, D7 RX) with SET on D2, powered from the XIAO 5V pin.
svg.text: Bayu Anchor, phase 0 on a half-size breadboard
XIAO ESP32-S3 + Wio-SX1262 · SEN54 (I²C 0x69) · PMS5003 (UART 9600) · SHT40 on a Grove tail (I²C 0x44) · 5 V USB wall power
D8 D9 D10 = LoRa SPI, leave empty
U.FL sockets at the left end:
pin 5 SEL to GND selects I²C
Side view of the stack, and the LoRa pigtail
The Wio-SX1262 clips onto the B2B connector on the top of the XIAO,
so the XIAO's own pin headers still go into the breadboard.
LoRa antenna: U.FL on the Wio board → pigtail → SMA bulkhead → whip.
WiFi antenna: the separate U.FL on the XIAO. Do not swap the two.
Never run the LoRa radio without its antenna fitted.
Header on the XIAO only, stubs trimmed flush: the Wio's edge pads over D0–D4 are radio lines.
D6 → PMS RXD and D2 → PMS SET.
Smart Citizen v5 only listens on D7
and never drives the PMS. Wire all
three: the same build runs both.
R1, R2 = 4.7 kΩ to 3V3. The bare
SEN54 has none; the Grove SHT40
Both sensor cases are tied to their
GND pin: keep them off other metal.
